i mean it's not really lying. she never asked. and i pay it from my own account.

I hear you. Since you're handling the payments yourself, it probably feels completely separate. 

But it still sounds like it's weighing on you since you felt the need to share it. Is the debt itself stressing you out, or just keeping the secret?
am i a bad person. just say it.

No, you're not a bad person at all. Good people get in over their heads and make mistakes, especially with money. 

The fact that this is eating at you shows you care about your wife and your marriage. How did the debt start building up in the first place?

Ah, that makes so much sense. You’re terrified of triggering her past trauma and being compared to him. I totally get why you've kept it quiet.
